nodes.label: Publish release step (gh release create)
nodes.rationale: Build with --publish never, then one gh release create, because electron-builder's parallel uploads could create two releases for one tag and split installer and blockmap.

nodes.label: Automatic updates via GitHub Releases
nodes.rationale: Checks at launch and every 30 minutes; installs silently when idle (not in party, no count change for 3 minutes) or on quit. Public releases are the feed; never embed a GitHub token.

nodes.norm_label: hosted rooms and public lobby browser

nodes.label: Streak rules
nodes.rationale: Per-player concurrent streaks with timed windows; leader takeover; host receipt order resolves simultaneous openings; computed on the relay.

nodes.label: Points leaderboard scoring
nodes.rationale: 0.25/chest plus 10% per streak level while leading, times lobby size; relay scores and signs results so edited history earns nothing.

nodes.label: Local storage of counts and history
nodes.norm_label: local storage of counts and history

nodes.label: Selected MiniHUD: Ledger (design prompts)
nodes.rationale: User chose the third layout and removed unneeded statistics; vector SVG only, no raster, glow or particles.

nodes.label: Mixed-version room compatibility
nodes.rationale: Rooms containing clients on 1.1.7 or older keep the old next-game-on-match-end behaviour so mixed parties keep working during updates.

nodes.label: Release notes 1.2.1
nodes.rationale: Fix: hidden popup window never asked to be shown again after first close.

nodes.label: Tiered streak windows
nodes.rationale: Make streaks harder to hold: window shrinks as flame tier climbs, replacing the separate leader window.

nodes.label: Hosted squad relay README
nodes.rationale: Always-on relay so players connect outbound instead of forwarding ports.

nodes.label: Ed25519 match signing key
nodes.rationale: Private key stays on server (gitignored); app ships public key in proof.js and only credits points for verified signatures; throwaway key means party points don't count.

nodes.label: Server-assigned host and immutable match-end snapshots
nodes.norm_label: server-assigned host and immutable match-end snapshots

nodes.label: relay/compose.yaml
nodes.rationale: Loopback-only port, read-only FS, all caps dropped, no-new-privileges; signing key mounted read-only as secret.

nodes.label: Saved state migration v2-v5
nodes.rationale: v2 folds own chests into team chests; v3/v4 only keep games of 3+ min and 5+ chests; v5 drops pre-recap games so HUD, Your stats and boards average the same games.

nodes.label: syncTeamChests()
nodes.rationale: Only count teammate openings observed while together; joining establishes a fresh baseline.

nodes.label: rankedPlayers()
nodes.rationale: In a party the relay times streaks; offline, local solo openings do.

nodes.label: checkPersonalBest()
nodes.rationale: Record pill replaces personal-best pill since a record is always a PB; each shows once per game keyed by game start.

nodes.label: finishMatch()
nodes.rationale: Games under 3 minutes or 5 chests are not saved and their chests come back off lifetime/session totals.

nodes.label: syncParty()
nodes.rationale: Send every signed result to each new room member so both sides end up with the same matches.

nodes.label: Mid-game click-through HUD
nodes.rationale: HUD ignores the mouse mid-game so it never pulls focus from the game; takes the mouse back once the game ends.

nodes.label: Milestone preview dev page
nodes.rationale: Developer-only preview of the eight flame milestone reveals and looping icons; not packaged, touches no real stats.

nodes.label: Outline HUD Mockup (A)
nodes.rationale: 224x344 dark panel with a You/Team two-column table (this game, lifetime, session, chests/match, chests/hour, token chance), streak line and squad Game/Total table; exhaustive table-style option

nodes.label: Inline HUD Mockup (B)
nodes.rationale: 248x348 panel with large 20px This Game and Lifetime chest numbers beside chest icons, then 'you / team' slash-joined rate rows and a one-line squad summary; emphasises headline counts

nodes.label: Ledger HUD Mockup (C, active streak)
nodes.rationale: Compact 224x214 layout: squad table (Game, Streak) on top with crown on leader and flame streak icon, then CTG/CPM You/Team rows and one shared team token chance. Here You lead (gold name, 10 chests, streak 3)

nodes.label: Ledger HUD Mockup (C, inactive streak)
nodes.rationale: Same Ledger layout where Nova leads with crown and flame streak 2; You has no streak flame, showing the inactive-streak state

nodes.label: Ledger Refined Concept Board
nodes.rationale: Presentation board 'Ledger - refined' (224x214px, SVG icons, one shared team token chance) showing the selected Ledger layout side by side in active vs inactive streak states

nodes.label: Match Recap MiniHUD Mockup
nodes.rationale: 184x126 post-match card: check icon + 'Match complete', big team chest total (23), per-player opened counts, best streak footer (Nova, 4 in a row)

nodes.label: Chest Tracker Logo
nodes.rationale: Gold-banded brown chest with gold lock on the HUD's dark rounded tile (#0c0d10); gold #e6bd67 matches the HUD crown/leader accent

nodes.label: Streak Flame Indicator
nodes.rationale: Copper (#c99465) flame SVG icon plus count in the STREAK column marks a player's current opening streak

nodes.label: Squad Leader Crown
nodes.rationale: Gold crown icon placed before the top squad row; leader sorted first

nodes.label: Shared Team Token Chance
nodes.rationale: Ledger design collapses the per-You/per-Team token chance from A and B into one shared team value to save space

nodes.label: HUD Dark Panel Style
nodes.rationale: Shared visual language: #181b20 panel, #30353d hairlines, 7px radius, Segoe UI 11/9px, muted #939da9 labels, tabular numerals, GAME N + timer + settings-slider icon header

nodes.label: Treasure Chest Motif
nodes.rationale: Chest imagery visually ties the brand to the app's purpose of tracking chests.
